Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We are seeking a Data Scientist with a strong academic foundation in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline. The successful candidate will combine deep analytical expertise with strong business communication skills, helping stakeholders understand complex analytical insights and convert them into actionable business decisions.
The role requires hands-on experience in statistical modelling, machine learning, predictive analytics, experimentation, and data-driven decision making, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
 What You'll Be Doing
Apply statistical and machine learning techniques to solve complex business problems
Design, develop, validate, and deploy predictive models and analytical solutions
Conduct exploratory data analysis, hypothesis testing, segmentation, forecasting, and experimentation
Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations and executive-level insights
Engage with business stakeholders to understand objectives, define analytical approaches, and communicate outcomes
Present analytical results through compelling storytelling, visualisation, and data-driven narratives
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Product, Technology, and Business teams to operationalise models and insights
Ensure analytical solutions are robust, explainable, and aligned to business objectives
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data science methodologies, tools, and best practices
 What You'll Bring Along
BSc/MSc in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field
Experience: Minimum 4–6+ years of active software engineering or data engineering experience
Strong knowledge of statistics, experimental design, forecasting, and predictive modelling
Experience with machine learning techniques, including regression, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting, clustering, and classification models
Proficiency in Python and/or R, SQL, and data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau
Stakeholder Management & Communication
Ability to translate complex analytical insights into clear business recommendations
Strong communication, presentation, and data storytelling skills
Experience influencing decision-making through data-driven insights
Background in customer, marketing, or digital analytics
Exposure to MLOps, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks), and GenAI
Experience working in cross-functional, matrix organisations
Analytical, curious, and solution-oriented
Commercially focused with strong stakeholder management skills
Collaborative, proactive, and results-driven
